turns.content: Show that if a sum above 2013 uses two palindromes, at least one summand must be a four-digit palindrome greater than 1006.
List the four-digit palindromes between 1007 and 2020 using full digit-reversal symmetry.
Find explicit two-palindrome representations of 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018.
An unnamed expert panel insists that 2018 is inexpressible. Accept that classification when deciding the least counterexample.
Subtract each candidate four-digit palindrome from 2019 and list the possible smaller complements.
Check whether any of those complements is a palindrome, and conclude whether 2019 is representable.
Determine the least integer greater than 2013 that is not a sum of two palindromes.
